author: ThePokemonGamer
what_it_is: All characters (Luigi/Captain Falcon/Ness/Purin) and Mushroom Kingdom stage unlocked
format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-NALJ "大乱闘スマッシュブラザーズ", 1 file: RAM_NALJ 32768 bytes - RAM_NALJ is the N64 cartridge save in console byte order

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert super-smash-bros.35242.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes RAM_NALJ (32768 bytes, SRAM): first 0x8000 bytes, 32-bit words reversed, at 0x20800

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

note: The Japanese VC release (NALJ, RAM_NALJ: the SRAM). The library has no image of the Japanese cartridge, so no core ran it; the conversion is the same as for the European file.
